principle: One school identity, one connected digital experience, one SIS core.
integrationRules: The public website must never become the source of truth for private student records.
Admissions creates a controlled applicant record before conversion to a student.
Parent Hub reads only authorised student information through SIS permissions.
Academic Results public pages expose only approved aggregate/public records.
Every sensitive SIS mutation must be attributable to an authenticated actor.
Student, staff and academic identifiers must remain stable across modules.
